Since \(a_5\) and \(a_9\) are the roots and their product is \(9\),

\[
a_7^2 = a_5 a_9 = 9.
\]

Thus \(a_7 = \pm 3\).  
The roots have product \(9>0\) and sum \(-2016<0\), so both \(a_5\) and \(a_9\) are negative. Since

\[
a_7 = a_5 r^2
\]

and \(r^2>0\), \(a_7\) is also negative.

\[
\boxed{-3}
\]
